description: Force issue merges to land as one squash commit with issue-level commit messages.

tasks.title: Add squash merge metadata and commit message formatter
tasks.description: Introduce the shared merge metadata contract and deterministic squash commit message formatter used by issue merge paths. The formatter should build an issue-level commit subject/body from issue number, issue title, and optional tasks.json data, and fall back gracefully when task metadata is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared merge metadata shape can carry issue title and optional parsed tasks to WorktreeManager merge operations
Generated commit messages include the issue title, issue number, and stable task summaries when tasks are provided
Generated commit messages still succeed with a concise issue-only fallback when tasks are missing or empty
Unit tests cover task-rich and task-missing commit message generation
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep artifact reading outside WorktreeManager; callers pass metadata. Do not add a merge strategy option.

tasks.title: Convert merge queue mergeBack to squash merge
tasks.description: Replace the merge queue's final fast-forward merge behavior with a forced squash merge through mergeBack(). The queue path should pass issue metadata into WorktreeManager, use the shared commit formatter, produce one base-branch commit, and remove fast-forward success wording from logs and messages.
acceptanceCriteria: mergeBack() no longer runs git merge --ff-only as its successful final merge operation
mergeBack() runs git merge --squash followed by git commit with the generated issue-level message
MergeQueue passes the issue title and available tasks metadata into mergeBack()
Successful mergeBack() messaging describes squash completion rather than fast-forward completion
Failures during squash merge or commit return clear retryable failure messages and do not clean up the issue worktree
Tests cover mergeBack squash success, no-commit no-op behavior, and squash failure handling
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: If MergeQueue lacks artifact access, inject a small readTasks dependency from server construction rather than coupling WorktreeManager to ChangeArtifactsManager.

tasks.title: Convert integrate-stage mergeApprovedCandidate to squash merge
tasks.description: Replace mergeApprovedCandidate() fast-forward success paths with the same forced squash merge finalization used by mergeBack(). Update the stage-context return type and integrate-stage output so successful merge results no longer expose fastForward and summaries state that a squash merge completed.
acceptanceCriteria: mergeApprovedCandidate() does not fast-forward an already mergeable candidate and instead creates one squash commit
mergeApprovedCandidate() preserves clean rebase/conflict detection before final squash for non-fast-forward candidates
Successful mergeApprovedCandidate() results omit the fastForward field from implementation and StageContext types
Integrate-stage task output, event output, summaries, and logs no longer read or emit fastForward
Integrate-stage passes issue title and tasks metadata from artifactManager.readTasks() into mergeApprovedCandidate()
Tests cover fast-forwardable and rebased candidates both landing via squash, and merge failure output retaining base/candidate/conflict details
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Remove fastForward rather than setting it to false. Keep rebased only if it remains useful as pre-squash diagnostic metadata.

tasks.title: Remove obsolete fast-forward expectations from tests
tasks.description: Perform a final test and type cleanup pass for the forced squash strategy. Remove or rewrite fast-forward-only assertions, update mocks to the new merge result contract, and add regression coverage proving the base branch receives a single issue-level commit.
acceptanceCriteria: No test mocks for successful mergeApprovedCandidate() include fastForward
No tests expect git merge --ff-only as the final successful issue merge operation
Regression tests verify a successful issue merge produces exactly one landed commit on the base branch
Regression tests verify generated squash commit messages include issue title and task summaries
packages/cli test suite passes
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Search for fastForward, ff-only, and fast-forward in tests and update only expectations tied to final merge strategy.
